constraints: No fixed events were moved, deleted, or overlapped: Machine Learning class, HCAI class, Agents lab, and the project deadline remain unchanged.
All proposed work blocks stay within the preference window of 08:00 to 23:00.
The Wednesday project block avoids the fixed HCAI class from 10:00 to 12:00 and the fixed 23:59 deadline.
The moved gym session stays on a weekday and does not overlap any existing event.
priorities: The HCAI project deadline is an academic deadline with priority 5, so it takes precedence over gym, which has priority 2.
The Wednesday gym session is flexible and low priority, so moving it is the smallest disruption that frees time on the due date.
A Tuesday evening project block adds focused work time before the deadline without moving any fixed commitments.

alternatives_considered.option: Delete the Wednesday gym session entirely.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Moving it to Thursday preserves the health/gym commitment while still freeing Wednesday evening for the project.

alternatives_considered.option: Schedule project work after 23:00 on Wednesday, close to the deadline.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: This would violate the preference of no events after 23:00 and leaves too little buffer before the 23:59 deadline.

alternatives_considered.option: Move a fixed class to create a longer daytime project block.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Fixed events cannot be moved or overlapped.

rationale.summary: The plan frees the most relevant time by moving the flexible, lower-priority Wednesday gym session to Thursday and reserving Wednesday 18:00–20:00 for HCAI project work. It also adds a Tuesday 20:00–22:00 project block to create earlier progress before the Wednesday deadline.
